faq_heading: Marpole real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Marpole is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 134 homes sold there: 23 houses, 82 condos, 11 townhomes and 18 duplexes. 82 condos sold in Marpole with a median price of $613,500 (the middle half sold between $509,750 and $786,250), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 1% sold above list.
Marpole home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

82 condos sold in Marpole with a median price of $613,500 (the middle half sold between $509,750 and $786,250), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 1% sold above list. They had a median $951 per square foot, a median year built of 2018 and a median strata fee of $501 a month. 23 houses sold in Marpole with a median price of $1,800,000 (the middle half sold between $1,637,500 and $2,065,000), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 93.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $800 per square foot, a median year built of 1959 and a median lot of 4,030 square feet.

faq.q: What did condos in Marpole sell for?
faq.a: 82 condos sold in Marpole between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $613,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Marpole?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (1% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Marpole sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 82 condos that sold in Marpole went for between $509,750 and $786,250, around a median of $613,500.

faq.q: Do condos in Marpole sell above asking price?
faq.a: 1% of the 82 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Marpole?
faq.a: Of the 82 sales, 82 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $501.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Marpole?
faq.a: The median year built was 2018 for the 82 condos sold in Marpole.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Marpole usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Marpole had 2 bedrooms, from the 82 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
